hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail cd "_scripts/recover/job_scripts_peds" for DATASET_NAME in 'recover_caregiver' 'recover_congenital' 'recover_pediatrics' do conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-2b115560-c8c4-4cec-8418-537a35f9c192' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi database_psql_host_address='recoverdb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB="${DATASET_NAME,,}_${VERSION,,}"
echo "testing connection to db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi #create common functions for use in multiple curation scripts PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f build_peds_shared_functions.sql &
#answerdata processing PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f answerdata/process_peds_answerdata.sql &
#biospecimen processing PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f biospecimens/process_peds_biospecimens.sql &
#demographics processing PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f demographics/process_peds_demographics.sql &
#visits processing PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f visits/process_peds_visits.sql &
#do fitbit and derived datasets for pediatric, they dont exist for caregiver and congenital if [[ $DATASET_NAME == 'recover_pediatric' ]] ; then #fitbit processing PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f fitbit/process_peds_fitbit.sql &
#derived core processing PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_core/process_peds_derived_core.sql & fi wait; echo "completed curation for ${DATASET_NAME}, moving to merge metadata for all runs into one table"; PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f metadata_curation/dataset_metadata_merge.sql done
